now.title: Marvel Zombies
now.text: In Paris, Peter defends the Infinity Hulk until the zombie Wasp pins him down. As Wanda's spell sweeps the world, his fate is left unknown.
cases: BY-019 The Battle for the Infinity Hulk (Marvel Zombies)

proposed.text: In Paris, Peter defends the Infinity Hulk until the zombie Wasp pins him down, and the horde kills him in the battle.

changes.evidence: Marvel Zombies episode 4 summary: 'the overwhelming hordes also kill Shang-Chi, Katy, Valkyrie, Rintrah, Parker, and Lang' in the battle defending the Infinity Hulk; the brief's settled convention also has Peter and Scott dying in episode 4's battle. Fandom (Episode 4) shows Peter cornered by the zombie Wasp in Paris. The record's 'fate left unknown' / Missing does not match.
